videos.script: Most programs remember only the latest state. Bia owes three hundred and fifty cents, and nobody can say why. {{state}} Event sourcing keeps the reasons instead. Every change is written down as an event, and nothing is ever rewritten. {{events}} The current state is not stored at all. It is worked out by replaying the events from the first one, in order. {{fold}} That buys things a table of current values cannot give you. The state on any past date. A screen invented today that shows last year's data. An audit trail that is the data itself. {{buys}} It also costs. Replaying ten thousand events to answer one question is slow, so you will add snapshots. {{snapshots}} Projections run behind the writes, so readers see the past for a moment. {{lag}} And events written years ago still have to be read by today's code, which is the part teams underestimate. {{versions}} You will build the whole thing on SQLite in about fifty lines, and run every piece of it. {{build}}
